offer.title: Welcome to Baby Pattern
offer.body: We'll walk you through the app together — highlight each area, explain what it does, and let you try it. You can skip anytime and replay later from Settings → Account.

skipHint.title: You can take it later
skipHint.body: No problem. You can take the tour anytime from Settings → Account → Take the tour.

tour.doAction: Complete the highlighted action to continue

complete.title: You're all set
complete.bodyFree: You now know how to track diapers, feeding, and sleep, check growth, review reports (last 7 days on Free), and manage settings. Record activities as they happen — Baby Pattern organizes them for you. Upgrade anytime from Pricing if you want longer history, PDF reports, and weekly summaries.
complete.bodyPro: You now know how to track care, growth, and pediatrician visits, review long-range reports and PDFs, use weekly summaries, invite family, and manage Pro settings. Record activities as they happen — Baby Pattern organizes them so you can look back with confidence.

settings.title: App tour
settings.subtitle: Learn the main features of Baby Pattern.

welcome.title: Your Profile page
welcome.body: This whole Profile page is your overview. You’ll see This month stats (diapers, feeding, sleep, and more), your activity calendar, your babies, and family members. We’ll walk through the main parts next. You can skip the tour anytime.

historyCalendar.title: Activity calendar
historyCalendar.body: This calendar is one part of Profile. Days with logs are marked so you can look back quickly. Each care page also keeps today’s entries in its own history list.

babyProfile.title: Your babies
babyProfile.body: Another part of Profile is Your babies. Add a name and birthdate (and optional details), or edit a baby later. When you log activities, make sure the correct baby is selected if you track more than one.

familyInvite.title: Invite family
familyInvite.body: As a Pro member, you can invite someone by username so you share tracking together. Relationship tags help you keep caregivers organized.

openMenuDiapers.title: Open the menu
openMenuDiapers.body: Tap the menu button to reach Daily care — Diapers, Feeding, Sleep, and more.

goDiapers.title: Open Diapers
goDiapers.body: Tap Diapers. Recording changes helps you see patterns over time.

logDiaper.title: Open the diaper form
logDiaper.body: Tap Log diaper change to open the full form for this page.

openMenuFeeding.title: Next: Feeding
openMenuFeeding.body: If the form is still open, close it first. Then open the menu to go to Feeding.

goFeeding.title: Open Feeding
goFeeding.body: Tap Feeding to track when and how your baby eats.

logFeeding.title: Open the feeding form
logFeeding.body: Tap Log a feed to open the full feeding form.

openMenuSleep.title: Next: Sleep
openMenuSleep.body: Close the form if it's open, then open the menu for Sleep.

goSleep.title: Open Sleep
goSleep.body: Tap Sleep to record naps and night sleep.

logSleep.title: Open the sleep form
logSleep.body: Tap Log sleep to open the full sleep form.

openMenuGrowth.title: Next: Growth
openMenuGrowth.body: Close any open form, then open the menu for Growth.

goGrowth.title: Growth & milestones
goGrowth.body: Tap Growth to record measurements and developmental milestones.

growthMeasure.title: Add a measurement
growthMeasure.body: Add measurement opens a form for weight, height/length, head circumference, date, and optional notes. Charts on this page show how those measurements change over time.

growthMilestone.title: Add a milestone
growthMilestone.body: Add milestone opens a form for title, category (Motor, Social, Language, Cognitive, or Other), date achieved, and notes. It’s a positive record—not a diagnosis.

openMenuReports.title: Open the menu
openMenuReports.body: Close any form if needed, then open the menu for Insights.

goReports.title: Open Reports
goReports.body: Open Reports to see summaries built from what you've logged — Overview, Sleep, Diapers, Feeding, Growth, and Health.

reportsRangeFree.title: Your report range
reportsRangeFree.body: On Free, reports cover the last 7 days. Baby Pattern helps you see patterns in what you've recorded — it doesn't prove health or replace medical care.

reportsUpgrade.title: Longer history on Pro
reportsUpgrade.body: Want 30 or 90 days, all-time views, or PDF export? Those are Pro features. You can upgrade anytime from Pricing or Settings → Subscription.

reportsRangePro.title: Choose a timeframe
reportsRangePro.body: With Pro you can view 30 days, 90 days, or All time. Pick a range that helps you prepare questions for your pediatrician.

reportsPdf.title: Download a PDF
reportsPdf.body: Download PDF creates an organized report from your tracked information. Use it as a reference — it isn't a medical diagnosis.

openMenuWeekly.title: Weekly summary
openMenuWeekly.body: Open the menu again to visit Weekly summary.

goWeeklySummary.title: Open Weekly summary
goWeeklySummary.body: Tap Weekly summary for a digest of recent activity.

weeklyOverview.title: Your weekly digest
weeklyOverview.body: This page organizes last week's logs into a readable summary. You can also turn on a weekly email later in Settings.

openMenuPediatrician.title: Pediatrician visits
openMenuPediatrician.body: Open the menu to find Pediatrician under Health & growth.

goPediatrician.title: Open Pediatrician
goPediatrician.body: Tap Pediatrician to keep visit notes in one place.

pediatricianLog.title: Log a visit
pediatricianLog.body: Log pediatrician visit opens a form for date, pediatrician name, clinic, recommendations, immunizations, and notes. Saved visits appear in Visit history on this page.

openMenuParents.title: Parents Corner
openMenuParents.body: Open the menu to visit the community.

goParents.title: Open Parents Corner
goParents.body: Open Parents Corner to browse and share with other parents.

parentsCompose.title: Parents Corner
parentsCompose.body: This community page lets you browse posts and share with other parents using the composer. Content is informational—it shouldn’t replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional.

openMenuPricing.title: See what's in Pro
openMenuPricing.body: Open the menu and tap Pricing for a friendly look at Pro features.

pricingOverview.title: Upgrade when you're ready
pricingOverview.body: Free covers everyday logging and 7-day reports. Pro adds longer history, PDF export, weekly summaries, and family invites. No pressure — upgrade only if it helps your family.

openAccountSettings.title: Account menu
openAccountSettings.body: Tap your avatar to open Profile, Settings, and more.

goSettings.title: Open Settings
goSettings.body: Open Settings to manage your account. You can replay this tour anytime under Account.

settingsSubscriptionFree.title: Your plan
settingsSubscriptionFree.body: Subscription shows your Free plan and how to upgrade if you want Pro features.

settingsSubscriptionPro.title: Your Pro plan
settingsSubscriptionPro.body: Subscription is where you review Pro access and manage billing.

settingsWeeklyEmail.title: Weekly email
settingsWeeklyEmail.body: Under Weekly summary, you can choose to receive the digest by email.

settingsAccount.title: Account & tour
settingsAccount.body: Account is where you can Take the tour again anytime. Theme lives in the side menu, not here.

done.title: Nice work
done.body: The most important thing is to record activities when you can. Over time, Baby Pattern organizes that information so you can look back on routines and patterns. Finish when you're ready.

diapersPage.title: The Diapers page
diapersPage.body: This page has a few parts: the title and description at the top, today’s count, the Log diaper change button, and today’s diaper history below. Daily care also includes Potty and Behavior in the menu if you need them later.

diaperForm.title: The diaper form
diaperForm.body: This whole form is where you record a change. Choose contents (Wet, Bowel movement, or Anything else), set the time, and optionally add brand, size, teething/sick, or cream. Tap Save when you’re ready—or Next to continue without saving.

feedingPage.title: The Feeding page
feedingPage.body: Like Diapers, this page has a header, today’s count, a Log a feed button, and today’s feeding history underneath.

feedingForm.title: The feeding form
feedingForm.body: Use this form to record a feed. Choose Breastfeed, Bottle, Solids, or Snack, then When, and optionally Amount (oz), Duration (min), notes, and teething/sick. Save when you’re ready, or Next to continue.

sleepPage.title: The Sleep page
sleepPage.body: This page shows sleep tracking at a glance: header, today’s count, Log sleep, and today’s sleep history.

sleepForm.title: The sleep form
sleepForm.body: This form covers a whole sleep session—nap toggle, start and end times, optional mood, quality, environment, wake-ups, and notes. Leave end empty if baby is still sleeping. Save when ready, or Next to continue.

growthPage.title: Growth & milestones page
growthPage.body: This page has two main areas: measurements (with charts over time) and milestones. You’ll also see counts at the top. Baby Pattern is for tracking—it doesn’t replace advice from your pediatrician.

reportsPage.title: The Reports page
reportsPage.body: Reports brings your logs together. You’ll see a header, a date range, tabs (Overview, Sleep, Diapers, Feeding, Growth, Health), and charts or summaries for the selected tab. This helps you spot patterns—not medical conclusions.

pediatricianPage.title: The Pediatrician page
pediatricianPage.body: This page stores visit history: a header with visit counts, Log pediatrician visit, and the list of past visits below.
